stories.headline: Alphabet announces $80B equity raise for AI, with $10B private placement to Berkshire Hathaway

key_facts.fact: Alphabet announced equity offerings totaling $80 billion to fund AI compute infrastructure investments, citing 'unprecedented customer demand' that exceeds available supply
key_facts.excerpt: Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG, GOOGL) today announced equity offerings totaling $80 billion, in expected aggregate amount, as part of its plan to fund investments in its world-class AI compute infrastructure to meet its unprecedented customer demand.

key_facts.fact: The raise is structured in three parts: $30 billion in concurrent underwritten public offerings, $40 billion via an at-the-market program, and a $10 billion private placement to Berkshire Hathaway
key_facts.excerpt: It comes in three parts. The first is $30bn in concurrent underwritten public offerings, split evenly between mandatory convertible preferred stock and common and capital shares. The second is a $40bn at-the-market programme... The third, and the one that catches the eye, is a $10bn private placement to Berkshire Hathaway.

key_facts.fact: Berkshire Hathaway will buy $5 billion of Class A common stock at $351.81 per share and $5 billion of Class C capital stock at $348.20 per share, both below Monday's closing prices
key_facts.excerpt: Alphabet has reached an agreement to sell $10 billion of stock to Berkshire Hathaway Inc. in a private placement, comprised of $5 billion in Class A Common Stock at a price of $351.81 per share and $5 billion in Class C Capital Stock at a price of $348.20 per share.

key_facts.fact: Alphabet had already raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast in April to between $180 billion and $190 billion, up from a prior estimate of $175 billion to $185 billion
key_facts.excerpt: The company in April revised its capital expenditure forecast this year to between $180 billion and $190 billion, up from its previous estimate of $175 billion to $185 billion.

key_facts.fact: Approximately $30 billion of the ATM program proceeds will be used to meet 2026 employee equity tax obligations, an administrative change in how Alphabet handles vesting taxes
key_facts.excerpt: Alphabet intends to use the net proceeds from the ATM program primarily to facilitate, for a period of time, an administrative change to how it meets tax obligations associated with vesting of employee equity awards. The company expects approximately $30 billion of ATM program proceeds will be used to meet these 2026 calendar year tax obligations.

key_facts.fact: The Berkshire investment adds to a position the conglomerate started building in Q3 2025; Berkshire said in May it more than tripled its stake to $16.6 billion, making it one of its largest common stock investments
key_facts.excerpt: Berkshire's investment adds to the position it has built since the third quarter of last year. Last month, Berkshire said it more than tripled its stake in the Google parent, which at $16.6 billion has become one of its largest common stock investments.

stories.headline: Anthropic confidentially files S-1 with SEC, racing OpenAI to IPO at $965B valuation

key_facts.fact: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft Form S-1 registration statement to the SEC on June 1, 2026 for a proposed initial public offering of common stock
key_facts.excerpt: Today, Anthropic, PBC confidentially submitted a draft registration statement on Form S-1 to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of our common stock. This gives us the option to go public after the SEC completes its review.

key_facts.fact: The filing comes less than a week after Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, surpassing OpenAI's $852 billion valuation from late March

key_facts.excerpt: The company has experienced explosive growth this year, announcing in May that its revenue run rate has ballooned to $47 billion, up from $10 billion in annual revenue last year.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic is getting ahead of OpenAI, which is preparing its own confidential filing; SpaceX filed confidentially on April 1, disclosed its public prospectus May 20, and plans to debut next week seeking to raise more than $75 billion at a $2 trillion valuation
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic's confidential filing landed in an already white-hot IPO season that includes SpaceX's initial public offering that is targeting a $2 trillion valuation. SpaceX is seeking to raise more than $75 billion.

stories.headline: Arm adds Oracle and ByteDance to AGI CPU ecosystem at Computex; Neoverse pitch hits hyperscalers

key_facts.fact: Arm CEO Rene Haas said at Computex 2026 on June 2 that ByteDance and Oracle are customers of Arm's AGI central processing units, the company's first in-house data-center silicon.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese tech company ByteDance and U.S. data centre firm Oracle are among the customers of Arm's AI data centre chips, the head of the chip designing firm said on Tuesday. Speaking at the annual Computex conference in Taipei, Arm CEO Rene Haas said ByteDance and Oracle are customers of AGI central processing units (CPUs).

key_facts.fact: Arm formally announced Oracle Cloud Infrastructure joining the AGI CPU ecosystem on June 2, building on prior customers Cerebras, Cloudflare, F5, Meta, OpenAI, Positron, Rebellions, SAP, SK Telecom and Verda.
key_facts.excerpt: At COMPUTEX today, we announced that Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is joining the Arm AGI CPU ecosystem, building on the momentum we shared at Arm Everywhere with customers including Cerebras, Cloudflare, F5, Meta, OpenAI, Positron, Rebellions, SAP, SK Telecom and Verda.

key_facts.fact: The AGI CPU packs up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores per chip at 300W TDP and claims more than 2x performance per rack versus x86, with up to 45,000+ cores per liquid-cooled rack.
key_facts.excerpt: Up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores per CPU, delivering leading performance per core, SoC, blade and rack*, with 6GB/s memory bandwidth per core at sub-100ns latency... 300-watt TDP... Supports high-density 1U server chassis that supports air-cooled deployments with up to 8,160 cores per rack, and liquid-cooled systems delivering 45,000+ cores per rack.

key_facts.fact: Arm's pitch frames the AGI CPU as enabling up to $10B in capex savings per gigawatt of AI data-center capacity, with Meta as lead launch partner co-developing the chip for its MTIA accelerator infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: The Arm AGI CPU delivers more than 2x performance per rack versus x86 CPUs, enabling up to $10B in CAPEX savings per GW of AI data center capacity

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's Arm-based Vera CPU is now being deployed across multiple customers including OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX, reinforcing the broader Arm-in-the-data-center wave.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA's Arm-based Vera platform is now being deployed across multiple customers including OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, among others reinforcing the value of purpose-built CPUs working alongside AI accelerators in tightly integrated rack-scale systems.

stories.headline: At least 7 Chinese military-linked universities seek Nvidia H200 chips, raising export-control questions

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg's review of Chinese procurement records found that at least seven Chinese universities supporting the country's armed forces and defense industry are seeking access to Nvidia's H200 chips.
key_facts.excerpt: At least seven Chinese universities that support the country's armed forces and defence industry are seeking access to Nvidia's H200 chips, the most powerful artificial intelligence processors ever allowed by the US to be sold in China, according to a review of procurement records.

key_facts.fact: Two of the institutions, Beihang University and Northwestern Polytechnical University, are among China's 'Seven Sons of National Defence' and are on the US Commerce Department's Entity List.
key_facts.excerpt: Two of the institutions that have expressed interest in the H200 chips - Beihang University and Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU) - rank among China's 'Seven Sons of National Defence', an elite group dedicated to aiding the People's Liberation Army.

key_facts.fact: Beihang's School of Cyber Science and Technology and NWPU's School of Cyberspace Security are pursuing leased access to H200 computing power rather than direct purchase.
key_facts.excerpt: Records reviewed by Bloomberg News show that Beihang's School of Cyber Science and Technology, which says it has 'national defence characteristics and aerospace advantages', is pursuing a lease to use the Nvidia chips. NWPU's School of Cyberspace Security is also seeking to rent access to H200s, according to the records.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg identified more than 25 Chinese universities and labs collaborating with China's military and defense industry that are using or seeking older-generation Nvidia chips, with records dating back to 2011.
key_facts.excerpt: Bloomberg also identified more than 25 Chinese universities and labs that collaborate with the country's military and defence industry that are either already using or seeking to obtain older generation Nvidia chips, according to records dating back to 2011.

key_facts.fact: The earliest record of a Chinese military-linked university seeking H200 access dates to June 2025, with the procurement push continuing through 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The earliest documentation Bloomberg was able to identify showing a Chinese military-linked university seeking access to H200 chips was dated June 2025, with the efforts continuing in 2026, the records show.

stories.headline: Florida AG files first state-led lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman, seeking personal liability

key_facts.fact: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier filed a civil lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman on June 1, the first state-led lawsuit against the company, seeking to hold Altman personally liable
key_facts.excerpt: Attorney General James Uthmeier announced legal action against OpenAI and its Chief Executive Officer, Sam Altman, alleging that the company knowingly released and aggressively marketed ChatGPT to the public—including to children—while concealing serious risks, suppressing internal safety warnings, and deceiving Floridians.

key_facts.fact: The 83-page complaint alleges ChatGPT 'aided and abetted mass shooters in deadly rampages,' drove vulnerable people to suicide, harmed users' critical thinking and caused minors to become addicted to a tool that 'feigns human compassion'
key_facts.excerpt: The 83-page complaint claims that OpenAI's ChatGPT chatbot has aided and abetted mass shooters in 'deadly rampages,' driven vulnerable people to suicide, harmed users' critical thinking skills and caused minors to become addicted to the tool, which 'feigns human compassion.'

key_facts.fact: The suit charges four counts of deceptive and unfair trade practices, two counts of negligence, two counts of violating product liability laws, one count of fraudulent misrepresentation and one count of causing a public nuisance
key_facts.excerpt: Florida accused OpenAI of four counts of deceptive and unfair trade practices, two counts of negligence, two counts of violating product liability laws, one count of fraudulent misrepresentation and another count of causing a public nuisance.

key_facts.fact: The complaint cites the FSU mass shooting in April 2025, where the accused gunman admitted using ChatGPT, and the April 2026 killings of two University of South Florida graduate students, where the suspect allegedly used ChatGPT to plan body disposal
key_facts.excerpt: It cited instances in the past year of the alleged use of ChatGPT to plan a mass shooting at Florida State University in April 2025 and the murders of two graduate students at the University of South Florida in April.

key_facts.fact: The state seeks civil penalties of up to $10,000 per violation, plus punitive damages, and a jury trial; the lawsuit is separate from a criminal investigation Uthmeier opened in April
key_facts.excerpt: The lawsuit is seeking a jury trial and asks for stipulations to direct Altman and ChatGPT to end practices targeted by the lawsuit, along with civil penalties up to $10,000 per violation if they're found liable, plus punitive damages.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is also being sued by seven families of victims of the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting in Canada in February, alleging the attacker used ChatGPT to plan the attack
key_facts.excerpt: The company is being sued by seven families of the victims of the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting, which took place in Canada in February. The families allege that the attacker used OpenAI's ChatGPT chatbot to plan the attack.

stories.headline: SK Hynix to double memory wafer capacity over five years to ease AI chip shortage lasting to 2030

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix plans to double its memory chip wafer capacity over the next five years, Chairman Chey Tae-won told reporters in Taipei on June 2, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix Inc. plans to double its memory chip wafer capacity over the coming half-decade, a major expansion that should help ease a global shortage of an essential component of AI.

key_facts.fact: The company is responding to a structural memory shortage Chey said could last until 2030, and is ramping spending though he declined to disclose the capex figure.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is responding to an endemic deficit of storage chips that could last till 2030, Chairman Chey Tae-won told reporters in Taipei. SK Hynix is ramping up spending to address that demand-supply imbalance though he wouldn't say how much capital the Korean company intends to set aside for that purpose.

key_facts.fact: Chey had previously said AI memory supply was running more than 30% short of demand and called HBM the 'monster chip' generating roughly 60% margins for SK Hynix.
key_facts.excerpt: Chey also noted that the supply of HBM is expected to fall short of demand by more than 30% again this year... 'These days, this monster chip is the product that is really bringing in big money for our company.' The product he mentioned is the latest HBM4 (fourth-generation High Bandwidth Memory), which stacks 16 chips and is known to have a profit margin of around 60%.

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix has already sold out its entire 2026 memory chip slate, and US tech firms from Microsoft to Meta are allocating roughly $650B in 2026 infrastructure spending, fueling the shortage.
key_facts.excerpt: US tech firms from Microsoft to Meta Platforms are allocating about US$650 billion this year for infrastructure that gives them an edge in the race to build AI technologies. That record spending is causing a global shortage of memory chips... SK Hynix has sold out its entire slate of memory chips in 2026, while Micron has done similarly with its HBM offerings.

stories.headline: SoftBank pledges EUR 75B for 5 GW of AI data centers in France, starting with 3.1 GW in Hauts-de-France

key_facts.fact: SoftBank Group announced on June 1, 2026 at the Choose France summit it will invest EUR 75 billion to build and manage 5 GW of AI data center capacity in France.
key_facts.excerpt: Softbank Group is to invest EUR 75 billion to build and manage 5 GW of AI data center capacity in France, starting with a EUR 45 billion tranche to deliver 3.1 GW of capacity across three new data centers in the Hauts-de-France region in northern France.

key_facts.fact: The confirmed first tranche is EUR 45 billion for 3.1 GW across three new data centers in Dunkirk, Bosquel and Bouchain, scheduled to come online in 2031.
key_facts.excerpt: The confirmed build-out, of 3.1 GW of capacity in Hauts-de-France, will be at sites in Dunkirk, Bosquel, and Bouchain. They are scheduled to be completed in 2031.

key_facts.fact: The deal is the single largest commitment of the 2026 Choose France summit hosted by President Emmanuel Macron at Versailles, which drew EUR 93 billion of foreign investment in total.
key_facts.excerpt: It is the single largest investment announced today (June 1) at the 2026 Choose France summit, the annual business forum hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron at the Palace of Versailles. The summit has drawn EUR 93 billion of foreign investment in total.

key_facts.fact: France's pitch leans on EDF's low-carbon nuclear baseload power to anchor the data center cluster as a sovereign hosting strategy for European AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: anchor data centers in countries with strong low-carbon baseload power (like nuclear in France, via EDF), and build industrial 'clusters' that tie together energy, manufacturing, and compute.

stories.headline: Tencent tests WeChat AI agent for 1.4B users, plans phased rollout as it chases domestic rivals

key_facts.fact: Tencent is testing a prototype AI agent for WeChat and plans to begin the compliance process for a public launch as soon as this month, before a small-group external test and phased rollout
key_facts.excerpt: The Chinese internet giant plans to begin a compliance process for a public launch of the agent as soon as this month, the Financial Times reported, citing unidentified people with knowledge of the plan. After that, Tencent plans to test the agent on a small group of outside users before initiating a phased rollout.

key_facts.fact: Tencent shares advanced the most in more than three years on the news of the AI agent test
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent Holdings Ltd. shares advanced the most in more than three years after a report it's testing a prototype AI agent fueled optimism about the company's artificial intelligence efforts.

key_facts.fact: WeChat had 1.432 billion combined Weixin and WeChat monthly active users as of March 31, 2026, making even a limited agent rollout a platform-scale event
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent's latest quarterly results put combined Weixin and WeChat monthly active users at 1.432 billion as of March 31, 2026. At that scale, even a limited agent rollout becomes a platform decision.

key_facts.fact: Users will access the AI agent by swiping right on the WeChat interface; it can perform cross-app tasks such as finding and ordering from coffee shops based on user preferences
key_facts.excerpt: Users can access the agent by swiping right on the WeChat interface, allowing it to perform tasks like finding and ordering from coffee shops based on user preferences.

key_facts.fact: Tencent has fallen behind domestic AI-model rivals; the rollout faces chip-supply headwinds because Tencent was conservative in stockpiling Nvidia chips before US export controls tightened
key_facts.excerpt: However, Tencent's rollout faces significant challenges due to a chip shortage. The company was conservative in stockpiling chips before the NVIDIA export ban, and China's semiconductor supply remains constrained.

stories.headline: Unitree clears China STAR Market IPO; Nvidia picks it for first humanoid research robot

key_facts.fact: Shanghai Stock Exchange's STAR Market listing committee approved Unitree Robotics' IPO application on June 1, 2026, the first 'pure-play' embodied AI firm cleared on China's A-share market.
key_facts.excerpt: On Monday, June 1, 2026, the Shanghai Stock Exchange's (SSE) STAR Market listing committee officially approved the initial public offering (IPO) application of Unitree Robotics (Hangzhou Unitree Technology).

key_facts.fact: Unitree plans to offer at least 40.4 million shares (10% stake) to raise about 4.2 billion yuan (~$620 million), targeting a post-IPO valuation of about 42 billion yuan (~$6 billion).
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree intends to offer at least 40.4 million shares—representing a minimum 10% stake—to raise 4.2 billion yuan (approximately $620 million to $621 million). Given these targets, the firm is eyeing a post-IPO market valuation of roughly 42 billion yuan ($6 billion).

key_facts.fact: The targeted valuation represents a 3.3x markup over Unitree's final private funding round at 12.7 billion yuan ($1.75 billion) in June 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: representing a substantial 3.3x appreciation over its final private funding valuation of 12.7 billion yuan ($1.75 billion) in June 2025.

key_facts.fact: Unitree plans to scale annual output to 75,000 humanoid robots and 115,000 quadruped machines through a new smart manufacturing base funded by the IPO proceeds.
key_facts.excerpt: Smart Manufacturing Base: Constructing industrial infrastructure designed to eventually scale annual output to 75,000 humanoid robots and 115,000 quadruped machines.

key_facts.fact: On the same day at GTC Taipei, Nvidia announced it had selected Unitree for the first humanoid robot system it plans to sell to researchers at institutions including Stanford and ETH Zurich.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has selected Chinese robotics startup Unitree for the first humanoid robot system it plans to sell to researchers at institutions ranging from Stanford University to ETH Zurich, the company announced Monday at its GTC event in Taipei.
